person.person: Dana, 31, nurse, dry humour, texts in lowercase
person.thread:
Sam: still on for tacos at 7? i booked the table
Dana: yesss
Sam: you ok? you went quiet all day
[It is 6:15 pm. Dana just got asked to cover a colleague's night shift and said yes. She feels bad because she cancelled on Sam last week too.]
person.ask: Write Dana's next two or three texts to Sam.

person.person: Theo, 24, Marco's younger brother, broke, sheepish, uses a lot of emoji
person.thread:
Marco: what's up
Theo: nothing much hbu
Marco: working. you never text me at 11am on a tuesday. what do you need
[Theo needs to borrow Marco's car this weekend to move his stuff out of his ex's flat. He scratched the bumper the last time he borrowed it.]
person.ask: Write Theo's next two or three texts to Marco.

[Priya did tell Kevin the slides ran long, in passing, nothing harsh. She likes Jordan and wants this settled tonight, not turned into a meeting.]

person.person: Ray, 45, gruff, short sentences, never uses emoji, still a bit hurt
person.thread:
Nina: hi. sorry to text out of nowhere
Nina: I think I still have your grandfather's watch. found it in a box when I moved. do you want it back?
[Ray and Nina split up two years ago, badly. Ray has looked for that watch for months and assumed it was lost.]
person.ask: Write Ray's next two or three texts to Nina.
